dedupe_keys.name: gps 2 gtfs a python package to process and transform raw gps data of public transit to gtfs format

description: GPS-2-GTFS: A Python package to process and transform raw GPS data of public transit to GTFS format is a software tool described in the paper "GPS-2-GTFS: A Python package to process and transform raw GPS data of public transit to GTFS format" in Software Impacts (Elsevier, 2025), produced by Shiveswarran Ratneswaran, Uthayasanker Thayasivam, Sivakumar Thillaiambalam. The ‘gps2gtfs’ package addresses a critical need for converting raw Global Positioning System (GPS) trajectory data from public transit vehicles into the widely used GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) format. This transformation enables various software applications to efficiently utilize real-time transit data for purposes such as tracking, scheduling, and arrival time prediction. Coverage: not tied to a place or time; the tool is generic. The linked page gives the code or the package; nothing was installed or run, and the repository link comes from a web search for the article, not from the article page. Licence: not stated (no licence on the Software Impacts record read on 2026-10-01; check the repository). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support turning raw bus GPS traces into GTFS feeds for transit analysis. Related: the paper is the Software Impacts article 10.1016/j.simpa.2025.100780.
